  - Number of individuals who did not receive Drug X = 400
  - Number of individuals who died of the cancer = 100
  - Risk of death = 100 / 400 = 0.25 or 25%

Relative Risk = (Risk of death for Drug X group) / (Risk of death for non-Drug X group)
